Annotation.String: The Dark Factory tracker for one Helix improvement: observed -> researched -> planned -> implemented -> verified -> deployed. Planner != approver; deploy is human-approved.
A verification run: cargo test --workspace (+ DST/TLA) against a Helix branch. Executor runs it when the run enters Running and calls RecordResult.
A Cedar-gated rollout to the dark-factory namespace. Approve is human-only; Apply triggers the kubectl executor (dry-run by default).

The human's selective pressure for directed evolution. A global-scope goal is system-wide population pressure (e.g. cost_efficiency/maximize); a cluster-scope goal is a narrower per-niche pressure. The breeding harness reads the active goals each generation and reconciles cluster goals against the global budget.
A Cedar-gated scale of the Helix StatefulSet in the dark-factory namespace. Approve is human-only; Apply triggers the kubectl scale executor.

A governed, independent Helix cluster deployed from its OWN git worktree: Defined -> Approve(human gate) -> Building (image built from the worktree) -> Deploying (per-cluster StatefulSet helix-<name> kubectl-applied to dark-factory) -> Live (+ Failed / Torndown). Approve is human-only.

One goal-directed variant the breeding agent produces for a cluster/niche under a FitnessGoal: Proposed -> Building -> Verifying -> Promoted (the niche's new champion) | Culled (failed gate / regressed goal / busted budget, with reason). Motivation links to a Symphony ImprovementIssue. The breeder infers the niche from Datadog telemetry only.

A governed queue move: relocate a queue's producers + consumers from FromCluster to a specialized ToCluster (speciation). Requested -> Approve -> Apply -> Migrating -> Done | Failed. The deploy-service executor creates the topic on ToCluster, redeploys the queue's workloads pointed at helix-<ToCluster> brokers, and stops the old ones.

A governed workload-speciation run (ADR-0102): the breeder classifies queues into one Niche FROM TELEMETRY ONLY, isolates that niche onto a niche-tuned TargetCluster (Genome = real Helix knobs), and migrates the matching Queues onto it. Proposed -> ProvisionCluster -> Provisioning -> RecordCluster -> BeginMigration -> Migrating -> RecordMigrations -> MarkConverged | MarkFailed. Convergence ledger so the loop never re-splits an already-isolated niche.

One pass of a Directed Evolution loop agent (observer|researcher|symphony|breeder): Running -> Succeeded | Failed. Carries the run's narrative Summary, Metrics (JSON), and ProducedIds (links to the ImprovementIssue/Breed/Deploy/CIRun it produced). Powers the reverse-chron Runs timeline.
A governed Kafka topic (queue) for the Workloads tab: Defined -> Active (+ Deleted). Auto-approved; no human gate.
